purpose: Test coupling and relaxation time after resolving the inner layer better. Uniform coarse parameter failures may conflate changed gauge with underresolution; they do not prove larger kappa can never help.
controls: The existing kappa=.001,tau=.02 inner-c7 run is the reference. Vary kappa alone at tau=.02, and tau alone at kappa=.001/.005. Hold the same physical support, map, mass, nu, CFL and KO.
interpretation: Low-frequency frozen damping is chi*kappa*w^2*k^2/2; high-frequency damping depends on tau as well. Neither is a nonlinear pass criterion.
acceptance: Pilot selection only; every candidate still needs at least three grids, both constraint and field convergence, timestep/shift/dissipation controls, and t=10 extension.
